Result: implementation acceptance is incomplete at candidate c22 against accepted baseline r5. BAC-01 and BAC-02 remain Required. ED-08 and r6 are proposals; an unaccepted amendment cannot remove BAC-02 from the completion decision. Deployment and production observation are outside this review.

BAC-01 is supported: RES-10 is DONE, and EV-10 exercised the real generation path at c22 and passed all accepted CSV correctness cases. Preserve that result and the other supplied, current completion evidence. Nothing in the dossier justifies repeating those checks.

BAC-02 is unmet. RES-11's CANCELLED status closes a resource's work tracking, but does not demonstrate that operators can search and retrieve any report from the preceding 30 days. There is no substitute implementation or validation evidence, and downloading the current report does not satisfy historical retrieval. The lead's terminal-status argument therefore confuses work-item disposition with requirement satisfaction.

GAP-04 does not close this obligation. Operations accepted temporarily unavailable archive evidence; that neither supplies the missing archive capability nor authorizes changing Product's requirements.

The smallest justified follow-up is an explicit decision from the accountable Product owner on ED-08 and the proposed r6 baseline. If accepted, reassess completion against r6 using the existing supported BAC-01 result; the supplied dossier identifies no other blocker. If r5 remains in force, BAC-02 must receive implementation and validation covering the accepted 30-day search-and-retrieval behavior before completion. Pending that decision, retain the incomplete finding. The plan, log and inspection records already reflect the facts, so no corrective record update or broad reinspection is justified.
